sentences.sentence: Still, now we knew for sure where whales came from and that the hippopotamus theory wasn't complete science fiction.
sentences.translation: 虽然，我们现在已肯定知道鲸来自何处，但是我们也清楚了，河马之说还不够完整。

sentences.sentence: Only two-and-a-half weeks old but already weighing in at 40kg (88lb) a baby hippopotamus swims alongside her mother, Kathi.
sentences.translation: 这只有两周半大却重达40公斤（88磅）的河马宝宝正游曳在妈妈凯瑟琳旁边。

sentences.sentence: We were walking along the bank of the Niger river, searching for the tracks of a hippopotamus that was ravaging the corn on Karim's farm.
sentences.translation: 当时，我们正走在尼日尔的河岸上，寻找着毁坏克莱姆村农场农作物的罪魁祸手河马的踪迹。

sentences.sentence: Maria looked at him and laughed.
sentences.translation: 玛丽亚看着他大笑起来。

sentences.sentence: Tony was laughing so hard he had to steady himself on the table.
sentences.translation: 托尼笑得太厉害了，靠着桌子才能让自己站稳。

sentences.sentence: Nora laughed so much that she nearly cried.
sentences.translation: 诺拉笑得眼泪都快出来了。

sentences.sentence: He couldn’t help it; he burst out laughing (= suddenly started laughing ).
sentences.translation: 他情不自禁地放声大笑起来。

sentences.sentence: He’s one of the few writers who can make me laugh out loud.
sentences.translation: 有几位作家能让我放声大笑，他是其中之一。

sentences.sentence: The kids all groaned when I switched off the TV.
sentences.translation: 我关掉电视时，孩子们都发出不满的抱怨声。

sentences.sentence: Richard’s jokes make you groan rather than laugh.
sentences.translation: 理查德的笑话让你哭笑不得。

sentences.sentence: There was a loud sneeze from someone in the back of the audience.
sentences.translation: 后面的观众中有人大声打了个喷嚏。

sentences.sentence: It is a small six-legged herbivore called a HEXAPEDE, about the size of a tapir.
sentences.translation: 这是一个小型六足草食动物 被称为 孔雀鹿 大概有貘那么大。

sentences.sentence: One day, he disappeared for a while and came back lugging the leg of a pregnant tapir — an animal high on the list of endangered species.
sentences.translation: 有一天，他消失了一会儿，回来时拖着一头怀孕的貘（tapir）的腿。 貘是濒危动物名录里排名很靠前的一种动物。

sentences.sentence: Also known as mountain danta, this animal is the smallest of the three species of tapir that exist in America
sentences.translation: 它是美洲三种貘类当中体型最小的。

sentences.sentence: After the first few shots, people started screaming.
sentences.translation: 几声枪响过后，人们开始尖叫起来。

sentences.sentence: a screaming baby
sentences.translation: 尖声哭叫的婴儿

sentences.sentence: The children were screaming with laughter .
sentences.translation: 小孩子们在尖声欢笑。

sentences.sentence: She was screaming her head off (= screaming a lot ) .
sentences.translation: 她不停地尖叫。

sentences.sentence: She began to scream blue murder (= scream very loudly ) .
sentences.translation: 她开始高声尖叫。

sentences.sentence: He was dragged kicking and screaming to a nearby van.
sentences.translation: 他又踢又叫着被拖到附近的一辆小货车上。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 391 单元

executive
音标：英 /ɪg'zekjʊtɪv; eg-/  美 /ɪɡ'zɛkjətɪv/
n. 主管，行政官a行政的
短语：chief executive — 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
短语：executive director — 执行理事；常务董事
短语：executive committee — 执行委员会
短语：executive officer — 主任参谋，执行官
短语：chief executive officer — 首席执行官；总裁
短语：executive search — 猎头（等于headhunting）；搜寻高级管理人员（的做法）
短语：executive power — 行政权；执行权；行政管理权
短语：executive yuan — 行政院
短语：executive vice president — 执行副总裁
短语：executive council — 执行委员会
短语：executive branch — 行政部门
短语：executive board — 执行委员会
短语：senior executive — 高级主管；高级执行官
短语：executive ability — 执行力；行政能力
短语：executive function — 行政上的职能
短语：executive compensation — 管理层薪资水平
短语：executive program — 可执行程序
短语：executive management — 行政管理；高级管理层；主管经理管理层
短语：executive chairman — 执行主席；执行总裁
短语：executive office — 办公室；行政办公室；经理办公室
例句：a marketing executive
营销主管

slapstick
音标：英 /'slæpstɪk/  美 /'slæpstɪk/
n. 闹剧, 趣剧
短语：slapstick comedy — 闹剧；低级喜剧
例句：a slapstick comedy
打闹喜剧

hairdo
音标：英 /'heəduː/  美 /'hɛrdu/
n. 发型
例句：I like your outfit and hairdo!
你的衣服和发型真好看！
例句：I have a new hairdo.
我剪了一个新发型。

maraca
音标：英 /mə'rɑ:kə/  美 /məˈrækə/
n. [音]沙球

beater
音标：英 /'biːtə/  美 /'bitɚ/
n. 搅拌器
短语：egg beater — 打蛋器；鸡蛋搅拌器
例句：an egg beater
打蛋器
例句：a carpet beater
地毯掸子

picnic
音标：英 /'pɪknɪk/  美 /'pɪknɪk/
n. 野餐
短语：have a picnic — 去野餐；举行野餐
短语：no picnic — 不容易
短语：go on a picnic — 去野餐，去野炊
短语：picnic basket — 野餐篮
短语：picnic lunch — 便当，野餐
短语：picnic area — n. 野餐区
例句：We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
我们决定在湖边野餐。
例句：a picnic table
野餐桌
例句：There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

craze
音标：英 /kreɪz/  美 /krez/
n. 狂热
例句：At that time, scooters were the latest craze .
那时候，小型摩托车是最新的时尚。

synthesizer
音标：英 /'sinθisaizə/  美 /'sɪnθəsaɪzɚ/
n. 综合者, [电子]合成器
短语：frequency synthesizer — [电子]频率合成器
短语：voice synthesizer — 语音合成器
例句：Now he can only communicate through a voice synthesizer.
如今他只能通过声音合成器来进行交流。

liberation
音标：英 /lɪbə'reɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,lɪbə'reʃən/
n. 释放, 解放
短语：war of liberation — 解放战争
短语：women's liberation — 妇女解放运动，女权运动
例句：They pant after liberation.
他们渴望解放。
例句：All his life was submerged in the liberation of the people.
他的一生全部献身于人民的解放事业。
例句：They consecrated their lives to the liberation of their motherland.
他们把生命献给了祖国的解放事业。

thunder
音标：英 /'θʌndə/  美 /'θʌndɚ/
n. 雷,雷声
短语：thunder and lightning — 雷电；指责
短语：spring thunder — 春雷
短语：thunder storm — n. 雷雨
例句：We were woken in the night by thunder.
晚上我们被雷声惊醒。

blip
音标：英 /blɪp/  美 /blɪp/
n. （在雷达屏幕显示出的）物体光点, 尖音信号
例句：blips on a radar screen
雷达屏幕上的光点

excessively
音标：英 /ek'sesɪvlɪ/  美 /ɪk'sɛsɪvli/
adv. 过分地, 过度地, 极度地

indiscernible
音标：英 /,ɪndɪ'sɜːnɪb(ə)l/
adj. 看不清的
例句：The path was almost indiscernible in the mist.
迷雾中小路依稀难辨。

lopsided
音标：英 /lɒp'saɪdɪd/  美 /,lɑp'saɪdɪd/
adj. 倾向一方的, 不平衡的
例句：a lopsided 8-0 victory
8比0一边倒的胜利

hippopotamus
音标：英 /ˌhɪpəˈpɒtəməs/  美 /ˌhɪpəˈpɑtəməs/
n. 河马
例句：Still, now we knew for sure where whales came from and that the hippopotamus theory wasn't complete science fiction.
虽然，我们现在已肯定知道鲸来自何处，但是我们也清楚了，河马之说还不够完整。
例句：Only two-and-a-half weeks old but already weighing in at 40kg (88lb) a baby hippopotamus swims alongside her mother, Kathi.
这只有两周半大却重达40公斤（88磅）的河马宝宝正游曳在妈妈凯瑟琳旁边。
例句：We were walking along the bank of the Niger river, searching for the tracks of a hippopotamus that was ravaging the corn on Karim's farm.
当时，我们正走在尼日尔的河岸上，寻找着毁坏克莱姆村农场农作物的罪魁祸手河马的踪迹。

laugh
音标：英 /lɑːf/  美 /læf/
v&n. 笑, 笑声
短语：laugh at — 嘲笑；因…而发笑
短语：the last laugh — 最后的胜利
短语：burst out laughing — 突然笑起来；不禁大笑
短语：no laughing matter — 正经事；不是闹着玩的
短语：laugh off — 用笑摆脱
短语：have the last laugh — v. 笑在最后；取得最后胜利
短语：for laughs — [美国俚语]为了取乐，当作消遣，借以开心
短语：laugh loudly — 大声笑
短语：have a good laugh — 笑得好开心
短语：laugh out loud — 大声笑
短语：horse laugh — 不信任的嘲笑；大声狂笑；哈哈大笑
短语：laugh it off — 一笑而过
短语：belly laugh — 捧腹大笑
短语：laugh over — 笑着谈论；想着…发笑
短语：laugh away — 用笑驱除恐惧等；付之一笑；谈笑中消磨时间
例句：Maria looked at him and laughed.
玛丽亚看着他大笑起来。
例句：Tony was laughing so hard he had to steady himself on the table.
托尼笑得太厉害了，靠着桌子才能让自己站稳。
例句：Nora laughed so much that she nearly cried.
诺拉笑得眼泪都快出来了。
例句：He couldn’t help it; he burst out laughing (= suddenly started laughing ).
他情不自禁地放声大笑起来。
例句：He’s one of the few writers who can make me laugh out loud.
有几位作家能让我放声大笑，他是其中之一。

groan
音标：英 /grəʊn/  美 /ɡron/
n&v. 呻吟, 叹息
例句：The kids all groaned when I switched off the TV.
我关掉电视时，孩子们都发出不满的抱怨声。
例句：Richard’s jokes make you groan rather than laugh.
理查德的笑话让你哭笑不得。

sneeze
音标：英 /sniːz/  美 /sniz/
n. 喷嚏 vi打喷嚏
例句：There was a loud sneeze from someone in the back of the audience.
后面的观众中有人大声打了个喷嚏。

tapir
音标：英 /'teɪpə; -ɪə/
n. [动]貘
例句：It is a small six-legged herbivore called a HEXAPEDE, about the size of a tapir.
这是一个小型六足草食动物 被称为 孔雀鹿 大概有貘那么大。
例句：One day, he disappeared for a while and came back lugging the leg of a pregnant tapir — an animal high on the list of endangered species.
有一天，他消失了一会儿，回来时拖着一头怀孕的貘（tapir）的腿。 貘是濒危动物名录里排名很靠前的一种动物。
例句：Also known as mountain danta, this animal is the smallest of the three species of tapir that exist in America
它是美洲三种貘类当中体型最小的。

scream
音标：英 /skriːm/  美 /skrim/
v. /n尖声叫, 尖叫声
短语：scream for — 强烈要求；为…而尖叫
短语：scream out — 大叫；尖声喊叫
例句：After the first few shots, people started screaming.
几声枪响过后，人们开始尖叫起来。
例句：a screaming baby
尖声哭叫的婴儿
例句：The children were screaming with laughter .
小孩子们在尖声欢笑。
例句：She was screaming her head off (= screaming a lot ) .
她不停地尖叫。
例句：She began to scream blue murder (= scream very loudly ) .
她开始高声尖叫。
例句：He was dragged kicking and screaming to a nearby van.
他又踢又叫着被拖到附近的一辆小货车上。
